meta.description: Mexico Market Snapshot from USD 1,500, Market Entry Study, Site Selection and Nearshoring comparisons, and an Advisory Retainer during entry.

hero.title: Four ways to make the call on Mexico.
hero.subtitle: Every project is scoped to your sector and the regions you're considering. Start small with a snapshot, or go straight to a full study.

snapshot.name: Mexico Market Snapshot
snapshot.includes: A quick view of a sector or product: market size, competition and the most attractive regions.

entry.name: Market Entry Study
entry.includes: A full study: demand by region, competition, channels, basic regulation, and a recommendation on where and how to enter.

site.name: Site Selection / Nearshoring
site.includes: A comparison of 3–5 Mexican cities on labor, suppliers, costs and infrastructure.

retainer.name: Advisory Retainer
retainer.includes: Monthly support during entry: suppliers, partners and follow-up.

note: All projects are scoped individually. We don't provide legal, tax or immigration advice; we work with local partners when needed.

closing.title: Not sure which one fits?
closing.body: Tell me what you're evaluating in 20 minutes, and I'll tell you which study makes sense, or whether none does yet.
